feeds.title: Adoption UK
feeds.description: Information and signposting on a range of adoption-related issues and campaign for improvements to adoption policy and legislation at the highest levels. Adoption UK is the leading charity providing support, community and advocacy for all those parenting or supporting children who cannot live with their birth parents.

feeds.title: Adoption Matters
feeds.description: Adoption Matters is a children's charity specialising in adoption and adoption support. That is all we do and we have been doing so for nearly 70 years. We exist as an organisation with only one purpose: to provide a comprehensive advice and support service for all those who are considering adoption, or who have been touched by it. Catch up on the latest news & events from Adoption Matters.

feeds.title: And then there were four | tales from the land of adoption
feeds.description: And Then There Were Four' is a emotional rollercoaster - sharing the emotional highs and too-tired-not-to-cry lows of creating a family through adoption.

feeds.title: Adopters for Adoption
feeds.description: Adopters for Adoption is a baby and child adoption agency supporting people who want to become adoptive parents. Read current adoption news and find out about upcoming events from Adopters for Adoption online.

feeds.title: First4Adoption Blog
feeds.description: First4Adoption is the dedicated adoption information service for people interested in adopting a child in England.

feeds.title: Daddy and Dad
feeds.description: We're Jamie and Tom - also known as Daddy and Dad, blogging gay dads of two boys via adoption. Our aim is to enlight prospective adopters about the adoption process, in particular the stuff that happens after the kids are placed with their adoptive parents (or 'move in' as our boys affectionately call it).

feeds.title: AI Coates
feeds.description: An adoption blog following a adoptive father's story and process Adoption Dad and his adoptive family.

feeds.title: Life with Katie and Pip
feeds.description: A story of adoption and making a Forever Family: This is the blog of our adoption journey; meeting our wonderful children Katie and Pip and our lives as family of four.

feeds.title: Then We Were Four - Building Our Family Through Adoption
feeds.description: We are a gay couple from the UK who have adopted two children. This blog is about our experiences right from the outset of the new adoption process and beyond. Since adopting we have started to write posts about adoption in general and how we have coped with events that may, at first, seem like normal situations but require different thinking to resolve.

feeds.title: Two Good Mums Blog
feeds.description: Many years ago, Laura's baby was removed from her care and adopted by Peggy. Here we share our journey of adoption; the milestones along the way, the wrong turns we might have taken, and how we gradually became traveling companions. Two Good Mums is our story. Little did we know that while we'd been merrily going our own way for over a decade, building our friendship over email and getting our families together every year, post-adoption contact had become a hot issue.

feeds.title: Diagrama Adoption
feeds.description: Diagrama Fostering and Adoption seeks to find safe, loving homes for the most vulnerable children in care. Our mission is to help find vulnerable children in care a safe, loving environment to flourish in, so that they may lead fulfilling lives and achieve their ambitions without fear of exclusion.
